images.title: A road shared into three equal days
images.purpose: Show dividing a length: a road of 18 km 900 m shared into 3 equal days of 6 km 300 m.
images.composition: One long road bar split into three equal day parts with the whole length above.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. ROAD: one long bar 1050 px wide and 100 px high (x 203 to 1253, y 330 to 430) split by exactly 2 thin vertical lines at x 553 and x 903 into 3 equal parts of 350 px, filled teal #0072B2, amber #E69F00 and green #009E73 in that order. Inside each part, in white or dark 44 px bold, the labels Day 1, Day 2 and Day 3, and under each part at y 480 the label 6 km 300 m in 44 px. WHOLE: one grey #6B7280 bracket above the bar from x 203 to x 1253 at y 290 with short end strokes and the label 18 km 900 m in 56 px bold at x 728, y 230. RESULT: across the bottom centre, y 650, one line of bold text 18 km ÷ 3 = 6 km and 900 m ÷ 3 = 300 m in 52 px. In all: 1 road bar, 3 equal parts. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: 18 km divided by 3 is 6 km, 900 m divided by 3 is 300 m
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Divide the km part and the m part by the number of days.
images.description: A road of 18 km 900 m shared into 3 equal days, each day 6 km 300 m.
images.context: Concept image for Dividing a Length. It follows the idea of the road laid in 6 equal days in your maths book (a length shared equally over days) and shows the concept's own example, 18 km 900 m in 3 days (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Point at the three equal parts. The slip to watch: dividing only the km part.
